A  career  lesson  I  wish  I'd  known  at  21 
 is  that  anything  worth  doing  takes 
 exceptionally  longer  than  you  expect  it 
 to.  And  until  you've  worked  a  thousand 
 hours  on  a  single  project,  you  don't 
 even  understand  the  amount  of  work  it 
 takes  to  make  something  great.  And  by 
 extension,  why  you  can  really  not  do  any 
 things  at  all  if  you  want  them  to  be 
 worth  doing.
